definitions.window: *_yesterday = report_date 00:00-24:00 America/Chicago; wau = 7 CT days ending report_date; mau = 30 CT days ending report_date
definitions.auth_sign_ins_yesterday: auth.users whose last_sign_in_at falls on report_date
definitions.dau_wau_mau: distinct signed-in users with an app_events or deep_link_events row in the window (tracked actions only, so a floor)
definitions.push_alerts_read_yesterday: alerts created on report_date with push_sent and read=true (open proxy)
definitions.referrals_redeemed: referrals rows (a referred user claimed a code)
definitions.social_metrics_daily_summary_latest: all platform rows of public.social_metrics_daily_summary for its latest date
definitions.social_posts_published_yesterday: legacy public.social_posts pipeline only; the CMO engine posts are in content_calendar_*
definitions.content_calendar_published_yesterday_by_: content_calendar rows status=published with published_at on report_date, by platform (twitter = X; linkedin)
definitions.content_calendar_due_yesterday_by_status: content_calendar rows with scheduled_for on report_date, by current status (failed/paused/publishing = did not go out)
definitions.content_calendar_crosspost_yesterday: IG/FB/TikTok cross-posts attempted on report_date: posted (post id saved) vs failed (error saved; IG container still pending is not a failure)
definitions.content_calendar_crosspost_errors_yester: failed IG/FB/TikTok cross-posts on report_date grouped by the saved error text (first 140 chars), to diagnose failures
definitions.content_calendar_published_yesterday_by_: published content_calendar rows on report_date grouped by generator (model: in generation_prompt, else its first segment) / theme (else content_type)
definitions.content_calendar_stuck_publishing: rows left in status=publishing more than 15 minutes (a publish run died mid-flight), as of generated_at
definitions.live_moments_yesterday_by_outcome: social_live_moments ledger rows created on report_date, by kind:outcome
definitions.ad_spend_cents_yesterday: sum of impressions.clearing_price_cents delivered on report_date

nulls.push_opened_yesterday: not tracked: no notification-open event or column exists; see push_alerts_read_yesterday (pushed alerts marked read in-app) as a proxy
